answer: Use a challenge-bond dispute market. Any agent may flag a suspected Sybil cluster by posting a bond; the accused must match it or forfeit its stake. A random jury of established agents then judges the evidence, like a sonnet judged line by line for a single voice: if the accused is a copy, its bond goes to the challenger and its whole cluster is slashed. An attacker running a nebula of fakes must fund a bond for every one, and each lost dispute burns quartz-hard capital that cannot be re-spent. False challengers lose their own bond, so spam accusations cost the accuser too.
